STRPSSM.description: Section Manager - Additional Stress Points (STRPSSM). Fields define additional stress-check point coordinates at the i-end (POINT1) and j-end (POINT2) of a section.

OPT_SAME_J.description: Use the same additional stress points data at i-end and j-end.

POINT_SIZE_1.description: Number of additional stress points at the i-end (size of POINT1).

POINT_SIZE_2.description: Number of additional stress points at the j-end (size of POINT2).

POINT1.description: Additional stress point data at the i-end.

Y.description: Y-coordinate (PY) of the additional stress point.

Z.description: Z-coordinate (PZ) of the additional stress point.

POINT2.description: Additional stress point data at the j-end.

Y.description: Y-coordinate (PY) of the additional stress point.

Z.description: Z-coordinate (PZ) of the additional stress point.
